meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **thick, fragrance-free cream moisturizer** kharidiye—gel ya watery lotion nahi. Label par **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, aur bahut dry skin ke liye **shea butter** dekhiye; sensitive skin ho to “non-comedogenic” aur “fragrance-free” chunें.[1][3]

**Achhe options:**
- **Normal–dry skin:** ceramide-based barrier-repair cream  
- **Bahut dry/flaky skin:** rich cream, raat mein upar se petroleum jelly ki patli layer  
- **Acne-prone skin:** lightweight, non-comedogenic ceramide moisturizer  
- **Sensitive skin:** fragrance-free, minimal-ingredient cream  

Face wash ya shower ke **turant baad halki damp skin par** moisturizer lagaiye—isse hydration better lock hoti hai.[3][5] Garam paani, harsh soap aur scrubs avoid karein. Agar itching, redness, cracks ya rash bana rahe, dermatologist ko dikhayein.
